title: Ladybug Random Walk on a Clock
full_prompt: Write a Manim scene where a ladybug lands on a clock face and performs a random walk along the clock's hour marks (0 to 11). The clock should have a working clock animation. The ladybug starts at 12 (0) and randomly steps clockwise or counterclockwise. Each visited number turns red, and the last unvisited number turns teal when reached. The ladybug's movement should follow the arc of the clock.

common_failure_modes.note: The code relies on an external SVG asset 'ladybug.svg'. If missing, it will crash. A fallback shape should be used if asset is unavailable.
Uses custom Clock class from manim_imports_ext. May need standard Manim equivalent if ported.
